newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Glass in 900 mln baht Vietnam venture.
newsitem.headline: Thai Glass in 900 mln baht Vietnam venture.

text.p: Thai Glass Plc has begun building a 900 million baht ($34.6 million) glass factory in Vietnam, the company said in a statement on Wednesday.

The facility, located in the southern province of Bin Duong, will be operational by October 1998 and produce glass containers and bottles, the firm said. The factory is owned by Vina Glass Industries Ltd, a 100 percent subsidiary of Thai Glass.

Australian-Vietnamese firm Hai-Van Thies Constructors will build the plant, Germany's Projects and Construction Management GmbH is project manager and Owens-Brockway of the U.S. will supply and install machinery, the statement said. ($1 = 26 baht)
